title: Weekend Call-In Staffing and Booking Notice — Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
Staffing desk questions and answers on weekend home collections (Mobile In-Home Collection Visit), **Specimen Collection Appointments**.

**What does the staffing notice change?** The weekend amount of a Saturday or Sunday home visit, according to how far ahead the visit was booked. The notice is counted in calendar days from the booking date to the appointment date, both on the visit record.

**The clause.** A weekend visit booked three days or fewer ahead adds 10.00 for call-in staffing, one booked 14 days or more ahead takes 5.00 off, and one booked four to 13 days ahead is unchanged.

| Notice (calendar days) | Effect on the weekend amount |
|---|---|
| 0 to 3 | Adds 10.00 (call-in staffing) |
| 4 to 13 | Unchanged |
| 14 or more | Takes 5.00 off |

**Where are the edges?** A notice of exactly 3 days adds 10.00; exactly 4 days changes nothing; exactly 13 days changes nothing; exactly 14 days takes 5.00 off.

**Example (hypothetical).** A Saturday visit booked on the Monday of the same week has a notice of 5 days: unchanged.
